_comment: Score cutoffs for the PEDDEP graded ATAC-seq QC report. 'higher': value >= cutoffs[i] earns -1, 0, +1, +2 (below the first cutoff = -2). 'lower': value <= cutoffs[i] earns -1, 0, +1, +2 (above the first cutoff = -2). 'status': FastQC-style pass = +2, warn = 0, fail = -2. Metrics not listed here are reported but not graded. Raw_Read_Pairs, Base_Quality, Sequence_Diversity, Aligned_Percent, NRF and PBC1 reuse the PEDDEP/SEAseq cutoffs; PBC2, FRiP and TSS_Enrichment follow ENCODE ATAC-seq standards.
